svg.text: THE FIRST BANK OF FRIENDS · the economy in one picture
Every arrow is a measured mechanism of the live Rare Friends protocol (Robinhood Chain 4663). Nothing here is deployed; the ledger contract is written and tested.

g.text: 1 EVERY WEEK THE PROTOCOL PAYS EACH FRIEND
RF from activations, hardwires, Reserve fees
WETH 5% of every swap in the RF pool
(sign once: the keeper claims into your box at 20x the gas)
2 YOUR SAFE DEPOSIT BOX
exact RF + exact WETH. No shares.
part of the pooled book the swap desk trades
claim any time: RF, WETH, or close in one step
RECEIPT: deposited | swap desk | toll rebate
| coming home, per asset
3 THE SWAP DESK, EVERY HOUR
BUY RF when 30% under its 24h average
not if down 25% in 72h (a collapse); RF max 70%
SELL RF when 30% over its average
only if it clears cost after BOTH tolls
half of the idle side per trade
most hours it waits
4 A REAL SWAP THROUGH THE POOL
the desk pays 5% of the WETH leg
on the way in AND on the way out
a round trip pays 9.75% of the notional
the volume is real volume; the toll is
real rewards for every activated Friend
5 THE TOLL COMES BACK: IT IS WHAT FRIENDS ARE PAID
streamed next week to every activated Friend by weight: members get back their share s
a round trip really costs members 9.75% x (1 - s): the more Friends bank here, the cheaper
break-even swing: 10.8% at one Genesis · 5.1% at half of all weight · 1.0% at 90%
6 TESTED, GOOD AND BAD
16 real 4-6% toll pools, out of sample:
beat holding on 7 to 9; median -0.6% to +11.6%
as more of the toll comes back; 1 in 4 lost 22%+
live on 22 more pools across 7 launchpads

svg.text: next week's WETH rewards for every Friend: the loop closes

g.text: WHAT KEEPS IT HONEST
pays the toll like every trader · sells only above cost after both tolls · never buys into a collapse · RF never above 70%
exit any time, no owner check, no pause · every box exact in RF and WETH · one pure function decides everywhere
not claimed: guaranteed profit. It is a swing trader with strict rules; the rebate is the edge only Rare Friends can have.
